services.name: Slip Rentals
services.desc: Covered boat slips are available for rent on either a nightly rate or annual rate. Nightly slips are based on availability at the time of rental and may be cancelled by the marina should the slip be needed for an annual contract. A limited number of uncovered slips are available seasonally during the months of April-October and are for pontoon boats only. $15/night plus $30 cash key depositUncovered Bank Slips: (April-October only)A limited number of these are available for $121/month or $968/season Here you will find answers to common questions about our boat slips and slip

blurb: Guests can stay in rustic motel rooms or fully furnished cabins with lake and mountain views. The marina offers pontoon boat and kayak rentals, covered and uncovered slips, and a marina store. Whitewater rafting trips on the Ocoee River are available for all skill levels.
